newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Kamaz gets $179 mln diesel plant credits.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Kamaz gets $179 mln diesel plant credits.

text.p: Russian heavy truck maker OAO KamAZ has attracted $179 million in Japanese credits to modernise a plant producing diesel engines which will meet Euro-1 and Euro-2 emissions standards, Kamaz said on Tuesday.
Kamaz said it expected to produce 75,000 diesel engines per year, but gave no time frame in a statement.
The Export-Import Bank of Japan had supplied a $150 million credit out of the total $179 million credit.
Japan's Kanematsu Corp and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries gave the remainder of the credit in a $437-million project begun last year, Kamaz said.
Kamaz said four Japanese companies had won about half the contracts, and that a total of 48 companies from Asia, Europe and the United States would take part.
Kamaz is located in the autonomous Tatarstan Republic in southern Russia.
